SELECT p.v2ProductName as product_name,
       SUM(COALESCE(p.productQuantity, 1)) as total_quantity
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`, UNNEST(hits) h, UNNEST(h.product) p
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
AND fullVisitorId IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`, UNNEST(hits) h2, UNNEST(h2.product) p2
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND p2.v2ProductName = 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
    AND h2.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
)
AND p.v2ProductName != 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
AND h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
GROUP BY p.v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT `_TABLE_SUFFIX`, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201704*`
WHERE `_TABLE_SUFFIX` BETWEEN '01' AND '30'
GROUP BY `_TABLE_SUFFIX`
ORDER BY `_TABLE_SUFFIX`
LIMIT 5

WITH inpatient_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    provider_id, 
    provider_name,
    AVG(average_total_payments) as avg_inpatient_payment
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
  GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name
),
outpatient_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    provider_id, 
    provider_name,
    AVG(average_total_payments) as avg_outpatient_payment
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2014`
  GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name
)
SELECT 
  i.provider_id,
  i.provider_name,
  i.avg_inpatient_payment,
  o.avg_outpatient_payment,
  (i.avg_inpatient_payment + o.avg_outpatient_payment) / 2 as combined_avg_cost
FROM inpatient_agg i
JOIN outpatient_agg o ON i.provider_id = o.provider_id
ORDER BY combined_avg_cost DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT nppes_provider_state as state, 
       SUM(total_claim_count) as total_claim_count, 
       SUM(total_drug_cost) as total_drug_cost
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
WHERE drug_name = 'AMLODIPINE BESYLATE'
GROUP BY nppes_provider_state
ORDER BY total_claim_count DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT cr.concept_id_1, c1.concept_code as code1, cr.relationship_id, cr.concept_id_2, c2.concept_code as code2
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship` cr
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept` c1 ON cr.concept_id_1 = c1.concept_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept` c2 ON cr.concept_id_2 = c2.concept_id
WHERE c1.concept_code IN ('L70', 'L20', 'L40', 'L80')
  AND cr.relationship_id IN ('Subsumes', 'Subsumed by')
ORDER BY c1.concept_code, cr.relationship_id, c2.concept_code

WITH monthly_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) AS avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) AS avg_wetbulb,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) AS avg_dewpoint,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) AS avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2010`
  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) AS avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) AS avg_wetbulb,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) AS avg_dewpoint,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) AS avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2011`
  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) AS avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) AS avg_wetbulb,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) AS avg_dewpoint,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) AS avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2012`
  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) AS avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) AS avg_wetbulb,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) AS avg_dewpoint,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) AS avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2013`
  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) AS avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) AS avg_wetbulb,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) AS avg_dewpoint,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) AS avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2014`
  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
)
SELECT 
  year,
  month,
  ABS(avg_air - avg_wetbulb) + ABS(avg_air - avg_dewpoint) + ABS(avg_air - avg_sst) 
  + ABS(avg_wetbulb - avg_dewpoint) + ABS(avg_wetbulb - avg_sst) + ABS(avg_dewpoint - avg_sst) AS sum_abs_diff
FROM monthly_avgs
ORDER BY sum_abs_diff ASC
LIMIT 3

WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS date_str,
    DATE(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)) AS date_val,
    ROUND((temp - 32) * 5.0 / 9.0, 1) AS temp_c,
    ROUND(prcp * 2.54, 1) AS prcp_cm,
    ROUND(CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) * 0.514444, 1) AS wdsp_ms
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '725290' 
    AND year = '2019' 
    AND mo IN ('01', '02', '03')
),
with_ma AS (
  SELECT 
    date_str,
    date_val,
    temp_c,
    prcp_cm,
    wdsp_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY date_val ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS temp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(prcp_cm) OVER (ORDER BY date_val ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS prcp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(wdsp_ms) OVER (ORDER BY date_val ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS wdsp_ma8
  FROM base
)
SELECT 
  date_str,
  temp_c,
  prcp_cm,
  wdsp_ms,
  temp_ma8,
  prcp_ma8,
  wdsp_ma8,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS temp_lag1,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS prcp_lag1,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS wdsp_lag1,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS temp_lag2,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS prcp_lag2,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS wdsp_lag2,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS temp_lag3,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS prcp_lag3,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS wdsp_lag3,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS temp_lag4,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS prcp_lag4,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS wdsp_lag4,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS temp_lag5,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS prcp_lag5,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS wdsp_lag5,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS temp_lag6,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS prcp_lag6,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS wdsp_lag6,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS temp_lag7,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS prcp_lag7,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS wdsp_lag7,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS temp_lag8,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS prcp_lag8,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date_val), 1) AS wdsp_lag8
FROM with_ma
WHERE date_val >= DATE('2019-01-09')
ORDER BY date_val

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) as year,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'PRCP' THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(value, 10) ELSE NULL END) as max_precip_mm,
  MIN(CASE WHEN element = 'TMIN' THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(value, 10) ELSE NULL END) as min_temp_c,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'TMAX' THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(value, 10) ELSE NULL END) as max_temp_c
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_*`
WHERE id = 'USW00094846'
  AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2013' AND '2016'
  AND (
    (date >= '2013-12-17' AND date <= '2013-12-31') OR
    (date >= '2014-12-17' AND date <= '2014-12-31') OR
    (date >= '2015-12-17' AND date <= '2015-12-31') OR
    (date >= '2016-12-17' AND date <= '2016-12-31')
  )
  AND qflag IS NULL
  AND element IN ('PRCP', 'TMIN', 'TMAX')
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

WITH species_counts_1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(tc.spc_latin) as upper_spc_latin,
    COUNT(*) as not_dead_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995` tc
  WHERE tc.status != 'Dead'
  GROUP BY UPPER(tc.spc_latin)
),
species_counts_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(tc.spc_latin) as upper_spc_latin,
    COUNT(*) as alive_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015` tc
  WHERE tc.status = 'Alive'
  GROUP BY UPPER(tc.spc_latin)
),
species_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    ts.fall_color,
    UPPER(ts.species_scientific_name) as upper_scientific,
    COALESCE(sc2015.alive_count, 0) - COALESCE(sc1995.not_dead_count, 0) as change
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species` ts
  LEFT JOIN species_counts_1995 sc1995 
    ON UPPER(ts.species_scientific_name) = sc1995.upper_spc_latin
  LEFT JOIN species_counts_2015 sc2015 
    ON UPPER(ts.species_scientific_name) = sc2015.upper_spc_latin
)
SELECT 
  fall_color,
  SUM(change) as total_change
FROM species_diff
GROUP BY fall_color
ORDER BY fall_color

WITH trips AS (
  SELECT 
    vendor_id, pickup_datetime, dropoff_datetime, passenger_count, trip_distance,
    fare_amount, extra, mta_tax, tip_amount, tolls_amount, airport_fee, total_amount,
    pickup_location_id, dropoff_location_id, 'yellow' as trip_type
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
  WHERE data_file_year = 2016 AND data_file_month = 7
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    vendor_id, pickup_datetime, dropoff_datetime, passenger_count, trip_distance,
    fare_amount, extra, mta_tax, tip_amount, tolls_amount, airport_fee, total_amount,
    pickup_location_id, dropoff_location_id, 'green' as trip_type
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_green_trips_2016`
  WHERE data_file_year = 2016 AND data_file_month = 7
)
SELECT 
  pu.zone_name as pickup_zone,
  do.zone_name as dropoff_zone,
  TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND) as trip_duration_seconds,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(trip_distance, SAFE_DIVIDE(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND), 3600)) as driving_speed_mph,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100 as tip_rate_pct
FROM trips t
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` pu ON t.pickup_location_id = pu.zone_id
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` do ON t.dropoff_location_id = do.zone_id
WHERE 
  -- Both pickup and dropoff within July 1-7, 2016
  pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP('2016-07-01 00:00:00')
  AND dropoff_datetime <= TIMESTAMP('2016-07-07 23:59:59')
  -- Passenger count > 5
  AND passenger_count > 5
  -- Trip distance >= 10 miles
  AND trip_distance >= 10
  -- No negative fare-related amounts
  AND tip_amount >= 0
  AND tolls_amount >= 0
  AND mta_tax >= 0
  AND fare_amount >= 0
  AND total_amount >= 0
  -- Dropoff strictly after pickup
  AND dropoff_datetime > pickup_datetime
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT indicator_name, indicator_code, value FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population` WHERE country_name = 'United States' AND year = 2020 AND (indicator_code LIKE 'SP.POP.TOTL' OR indicator_code LIKE 'SP.RUR.TOTL' OR indicator_code LIKE 'SP.URB.TOTL') ORDER BY indicator_code

SELECT 
  cc.county_name,
  cc.state,
  c.median_age,
  CAST(c.total_pop AS INT64) as total_pop,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cc._2020_08_27 * 100000, c.total_pop), 2) as cases_per_100k,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(d._2020_08_27 * 100000, c.total_pop), 2) as deaths_per_100k,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(d._2020_08_27 * 100, cc._2020_08_27), 2) as case_fatality_rate_pct
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2020_5yr` c
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.covid19_usafacts.confirmed_cases` cc
  ON c.geo_id = cc.county_fips_code
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.covid19_usafacts.deaths` d
  ON c.geo_id = d.county_fips_code
WHERE c.total_pop > 50000
  AND cc._2020_08_27 > 0
  AND d._2020_08_27 > 0
ORDER BY case_fatality_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH ca_2015 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, median_income AS median_income_2015
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr`
  WHERE geo_id LIKE '06%'
),
ca_2018 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, median_income AS median_income_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr`
  WHERE geo_id LIKE '06%'
)
SELECT 
  t1.geo_id,
  t1.median_income_2015,
  t2.median_income_2018,
  t2.median_income_2018 - t1.median_income_2015 AS income_increase
FROM ca_2015 t1
JOIN ca_2018 t2 ON t1.geo_id = t2.geo_id
WHERE t1.median_income_2015 IS NOT NULL AND t2.median_income_2018 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY income_increase DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  game_clock,
  SUM(CASE WHEN team_name = 'Wildcats' THEN points_scored ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY elapsed_time_sec, event_id) AS wildcats_score,
  SUM(CASE WHEN team_name = 'Fighting Irish' THEN points_scored ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY elapsed_time_sec, event_id) AS fighting_irish_score,
  team_name AS team_that_scored,
  event_description
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
WHERE game_id = '95cda731-b593-42cd-8573-621a3d1369dc'
  AND points_scored > 0
ORDER BY elapsed_time_sec, event_id

-- Final query: Top 5 universities with most peak-performance seasons (1900-2000)
WITH max_wins_per_season AS (
  SELECT season, MAX(wins) as max_wins
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_teams_seasons`
  WHERE season BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000
    AND name IS NOT NULL
    AND name != ''
  GROUP BY season
),
peak_teams AS (
  SELECT s.season, s.name, s.market, s.wins
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_teams_seasons` s
  JOIN max_wins_per_season m ON s.season = m.season
  WHERE s.wins = m.max_wins
    AND s.name IS NOT NULL
    AND s.name != ''
)
SELECT market as university_name, COUNT(*) as peak_performance_seasons
FROM peak_teams
GROUP BY market
ORDER BY peak_performance_seasons DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH google_hiring AS (
  SELECT 
    'Google Overall Hiring' AS category,
    CASE WHEN gender_us = 'women' THEN 'U.S. Women' ELSE 'U.S. Men' END AS gender,
    CAST(report_year AS STRING) AS report_year,
    CONCAT(ROUND(race_asian * 100, 1), '%') AS asian,
    CONCAT(ROUND(race_black * 100, 1), '%') AS black,
    CONCAT(ROUND(COALESCE(race_hispanic_latinx, 0) * 100, 1), '%') AS hispanic_latinx,
    CONCAT(ROUND(race_white * 100, 1), '%') AS white
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_intersectional_hiring`
  WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
google_representation AS (
  SELECT 
    'Google Overall Representation' AS category,
    CASE WHEN gender_us = 'women' THEN 'U.S. Women' ELSE 'U.S. Men' END AS gender,
    CAST(report_year AS STRING) AS report_year,
    CONCAT(ROUND(race_asian * 100, 1), '%') AS asian,
    CONCAT(ROUND(race_black * 100, 1), '%') AS black,
    CONCAT(ROUND(COALESCE(race_hispanic_latinx, 0) * 100, 1), '%') AS hispanic_latinx,
    CONCAT(ROUND(race_white * 100, 1), '%') AS white
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_intersectional_representation`
  WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
bls_tech AS (
  SELECT 
    'BLS Internet Publishing & Web Search Portals' AS category,
    'Total Workforce' AS gender,
    CAST(year AS STRING) AS report_year,
    CONCAT(ROUND(percent_asian * 100, 1), '%') AS asian,
    CONCAT(ROUND(percent_black_or_african_american * 100, 1), '%') AS black,
    CONCAT(ROUND(percent_hispanic_or_latino * 100, 1), '%') AS hispanic_latinx,
    CONCAT(ROUND(percent_white * 100, 1), '%') AS white
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18`
  WHERE year = 2021 AND subsector = 'Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'BLS Computer Systems Design & Related Services' AS category,
    'Total Workforce' AS gender,
    CAST(year AS STRING) AS report_year,
    CONCAT(ROUND(percent_asian * 100, 1), '%') AS asian,
    CONCAT(ROUND(percent_black_or_african_american * 100, 1), '%') AS black,
    CONCAT(ROUND(percent_hispanic_or_latino * 100, 1), '%') AS hispanic_latinx,
    CONCAT(ROUND(percent_white * 100, 1), '%') AS white
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18`
  WHERE year = 2021 AND industry_group = 'Computer systems design and related services'
)
SELECT category, gender, report_year, asian, black, hispanic_latinx, white
FROM google_hiring
UNION ALL
SELECT category, gender, report_year, asian, black, hispanic_latinx, white
FROM google_representation
UNION ALL
SELECT category, gender, report_year, asian, black, hispanic_latinx, white
FROM bls_tech
ORDER BY category, gender

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(trip_seconds, 60) AS trip_minutes,
    fare
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600
    AND fare IS NOT NULL
),
trips_with_quantile AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_minutes,
    fare,
    NTILE(6) OVER (ORDER BY trip_minutes) AS quantile_group
  FROM filtered_trips
)
SELECT 
  quantile_group,
  ROUND(MIN(trip_minutes)) AS min_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(MAX(trip_minutes)) AS max_duration_minutes,
  COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
  AVG(fare) AS average_fare
FROM trips_with_quantile
GROUP BY quantile_group
ORDER BY quantile_group

WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    company,
    DATE_TRUNC(trip_start_timestamp, MONTH) AS trip_month,
    COUNT(*) AS trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM trip_start_timestamp) = 2018
    AND company IS NOT NULL
    AND company != ''
  GROUP BY company, DATE_TRUNC(trip_start_timestamp, MONTH)
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT 
    company,
    trip_month,
    trip_count,
    LAG(trip_count) OVER (PARTITION BY company ORDER BY trip_month) AS prev_month_count
  FROM monthly_counts
),
with_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    company,
    trip_month,
    trip_count,
    prev_month_count,
    trip_count - prev_month_count AS increase
  FROM with_prev
  WHERE prev_month_count IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT company, trip_month, increase
FROM with_diff
ORDER BY increase DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH strategy_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN TargetCompID LIKE 'LUCKY%' THEN 'feeling_lucky'
         WHEN TargetCompID LIKE 'MOMO%' THEN 'momentum'
         ELSE 'other'
    END as strategy,
    AVG((StrikePrice - LastPx) * Quantity) as avg_intrinsic_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cymbal_investments.trade_capture_report`, 
       UNNEST(Sides) AS s
  WHERE (TargetCompID LIKE 'LUCKY%' OR TargetCompID LIKE 'MOMO%')
    AND Side = 'LONG'
  GROUP BY strategy
)
SELECT 
  MAX(CASE WHEN strategy = 'feeling_lucky' THEN avg_intrinsic_value END) -
  MAX(CASE WHEN strategy = 'momentum' THEN avg_intrinsic_value END) as difference
FROM strategy_avg

-- Final approach: use ST_WITHIN with buffer based on r34 values
SELECT p.port_name, COUNT(*) as appearance_count
FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_international_ports.world_port_index` p
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.states` s
  ON ST_WITHIN(p.port_geom, s.state_geom)
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` h
  ON ST_WITHIN(p.port_geom, ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(h.usa_longitude, h.usa_latitude), 
    GREATEST(COALESCE(h.usa_r34_ne, 0), COALESCE(h.usa_r34_se, 0), COALESCE(h.usa_r34_sw, 0), COALESCE(h.usa_r34_nw, 0)) * 1852))
WHERE p.region_number = '6585'
  AND h.basin = 'NA'
  AND h.name != 'NOT_NAMED'
  AND h.usa_wind >= 35

WITH paad_patients AS (

  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample` m
  WHERE m.Study = 'PAAD' AND m.Hugo_Symbol IN ('KRAS', 'TP53')
),
all_paad_mutation_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode as patient_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`
  WHERE Study = 'PAAD'
),
patient_mutations AS (
  SELECT 
    pp.patient_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN md.Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_kras,
    MAX(CASE WHEN md.Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_tp53
  FROM paad_patients pp
  LEFT JOIN mutation_data md ON pp.patient_id = md.patient_id
  WHERE pp.patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM all_paad_mutation_patients)
  GROUP BY pp.patient_id
),
contingency AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as a,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as b,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as c,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as d,
    COUNT(*) as total
  FROM patient_mutations
),
chi_squared_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    a, b, c, d, total,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(a - SAFE_DIVIDE((a+b)*(a+c), (a+b+c+d)), 2), SAFE_DIVIDE((a+b)*(a+c), (a+b+c+d))) 
    + SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(b - SAFE_DIVIDE((a+b)*(b+d), (a+b+c+d)), 2), SAFE_DIVIDE((a+b)*(b+d), (a+b+c+d)))
    + SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(c - SAFE_DIVIDE((c+d)*(a+c), (a+b+c+d)), 2), SAFE_DIVIDE((c+d)*(a+c), (a+b+c+d)))
    + SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(d - SAFE_DIVIDE((c+d)*(b+d), (a+b+c+d)), 2), SAFE_DIVIDE((c+d)*(b+d), (a+b+c+d)))
    as chi_squared_statistic
  FROM contingency
)
SELECT chi_squared_statistic FROM chi_squared_calc

WITH session_params AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN e.key = 'ga_session_id' THEN e.value.int_value END) FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS e) as session_id,
    (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN e.key = 'medium' THEN e.value.string_value END) FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS e) as medium,
    (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN e.key = 'source' THEN e.value.string_value END) FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS e) as source,
    (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN e.key = 'campaign' THEN e.value.string_value END) FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS e) as campaign
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
),
distinct_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session_id, medium, source
  FROM session_params
  WHERE session_id IS NOT NULL
),
session_campaign AS (
  SELECT session_id, MAX(campaign) as campaign
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN e.key = 'ga_session_id' THEN e.value.int_value END) FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS e) as session_id,
      (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN e.key = 'campaign' THEN e.value.string_value END) FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS e) as campaign
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
  )
  GROUP BY session_id
),
with_channel AS (
  SELECT 
    s.session_id,
    s.medium,
    s.source,
    sc.campaign
  FROM distinct_sessions s
  LEFT JOIN session_campaign sc ON s.session_id = sc.session_id
)
SELECT channel_group, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) as total_sessions
FROM (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('badoo', 'facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'twitter', 'whatsapp') 
           OR LOWER(medium) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('badoo', 'facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'twitter', 'whatsapp') 
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'(cp|ppc|retargeting|paid)') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch') 
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'video') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch') 
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'(cp|ppc|retargeting|paid)') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') 
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign), r'(shop|shopping)') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') 
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'(cp|ppc|retargeting|paid)') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('google', 'bing', 'yahoo', 'baidu', 'yandex', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia') 
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'(cp|ppc|paid)') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('google', 'bing', 'yahoo', 'baidu', 'yandex', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia') THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END as channel_group
  FROM with_channel
)
GROUP BY channel_group
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC

-- Final query: retention rate for users two weeks after their initial quickplay event
-- Grouped by quickplay event type (event_name)
WITH session_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20180716'
    AND event_name = 'session_start'
),
quickplay_events AS (
  SELECT 
    s.user_pseudo_id,
    e.event_name,
    e.event_timestamp,
    e.event_date
  FROM session_users s
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON s.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE e.event_name LIKE '%quickplay%'
),
initial_quickplay AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    event_name,
    event_timestamp,
    event_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_pseudo_id ORDER BY event_timestamp ASC) as rn
  FROM quickplay_events
),
first_quickplay AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    event_name as initial_event_name,
    event_timestamp as initial_event_ts
  FROM initial_quickplay
  WHERE rn = 1
),
retention_check AS (
  SELECT 
    f.user_pseudo_id,
    f.initial_event_name,
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_timestamp IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained
  FROM first_quickplay f
  LEFT JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON f.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
    AND e.event_name LIKE '%quickplay%'
    AND e.event_timestamp > f.initial_event_ts
    AND e.event_timestamp <= f.initial_event_ts + 14 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000000
  GROUP BY f.user_pseudo_id, f.initial_event_name
)
SELECT 
  initial_event_name as quickplay_event_type,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(retained), COUNT(*)), 4) as retention_rate
FROM retention_check
GROUP BY initial_event_name
ORDER BY initial_event_name
